scope: Original English basic-board standard semi-cooperative Nemesis, six original characters. English original manual including illustrated card text and scoped currentFAQ govern; PL/FR/DE original manuals supplement compatible details and expose differences without automatic precedence.
conclusion: The governing English-core procedures and scoped FAQ remain substantially faithful, and the earlier Energy Charge error and two unsupported clauses are repaired in these exact bytes. One newly added target-range qualifier is not established by the allowed sources. It should be removed or explicitly left to an authoritative card/range clarification. This is a source-support finding, not proof that remote medical use is legal. Selected-example/actual-card scope is now explicit; a complete card-level core certificate remains unavailable.

method.fixed_candidate: Read the whole exact candidate09 snapshot, including all repeated reference sections, rather than only reviewing a diff.
method.retained_review: The completed source-only review of identical-hash English standard-core rules, scoped FAQ and actually used localized corroboration is retained explicitly. No prior reader or coverage evidence was used.
method.new_inspection: Re-rendered the allowed English PDF through existing .venv/bin/python/fitz. Inspected enlarged p.13 Action and Item groups, Basic Repairs, and p.19 combat/Pistol illustration. Rechecked cost icons, visible Combat icons, alternatives, targets and escape/damage exceptions. Rechecked relevant raw FAQ text for Full Auto, medical permission and Action restrictions. Previously inspected pp.22-23 card/weapon/Quest illustrations remain applicable because their source bytes are unchanged.
method.scope_boundary: An omission is not automatically an error under the now-explicit selected-example/actual-card scope. No complete procedures are inferred from unreadable tiny card text.
method.durable_output: Only candidate09/source-audit.json. Temporary source-derived crops under /tmp.

findings.summary_location: Item and Weapon effects illustrated in the manual, Medkit paragraph after the Item table
findings.claim: Medkit can treat another Character in your Room, as can Bandages.
findings.source_result: The English Medkit illustration on p.13 establishes cost 1, One Use Only, Dress 1 Serious Wound OR Heal 1 Dressed Serious Wound. English Bandages on pp.22-23 establishes its own treatment alternatives and restrictions. FAQ Items 2 confirms that both may be used on other players, but its answer does not state a target range. These texts do not expressly establish the newly added same-Room qualifier. The basic Items/Inventory rules do not supply a general target-distance rule that resolves this.
findings.impact: The sentence presents a targeting restriction as established when the packet only expressly supports permission to treat another Character.
findings.required_change: Remove the added same-Room qualifier, retaining FAQ Items 2 permission, or leave unstated targeting conditions to the actual card/matching authoritative clarification. Do not infer that omitting this qualifier establishes remote medical use.
